add_executable(binweaver-tests
  test_core.cpp
  test_pe.cpp
  test_elf.cpp
  test_diff.cpp
  test_robustness.cpp
  test_real.cpp)
target_link_libraries(binweaver-tests PRIVATE binweaver_core)
target_compile_definitions(binweaver-tests PRIVATE BINWEAVER_SOURCE_DIR="${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}")
binweaver_warnings(binweaver-tests)

foreach(area core pe elf diff robust real)
  add_test(NAME ${area} COMMAND binweaver-tests ${area}.)
endforeach()

# Corpus generator and replay: tests/corpus holds small seed and malformed
# inputs (generated by binweaver-make-corpus); every file must analyze
# without crashing and produce valid reports.
add_executable(binweaver-make-corpus make_corpus.cpp)
target_link_libraries(binweaver-make-corpus PRIVATE binweaver_core)

add_executable(binweaver-replay ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/fuzz/fuzz_analyze.cpp ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/fuzz/replay_main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(binweaver-replay PRIVATE binweaver_core)
add_test(NAME corpus-replay COMMAND binweaver-replay ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus)

# CLI smoke tests: exit codes and output shape.
add_test(NAME cli-usage COMMAND binweaver-cli)
set_tests_properties(cli-usage PROPERTIES WILL_FAIL TRUE)
add_test(NAME cli-inspect-clean COMMAND binweaver-cli inspect ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/pe/clean-pe32plus.dll)
add_test(NAME cli-inspect-json COMMAND binweaver-cli inspect ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/elf/clean-elf64le.so --json)
set_tests_properties(cli-inspect-json PROPERTIES PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "\"schema_version\": 2")
add_test(NAME cli-inspect-malformed COMMAND binweaver-cli inspect ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/pe/bad-lfanew.exe)
set_tests_properties(cli-inspect-malformed PROPERTIES WILL_FAIL TRUE)
add_test(NAME cli-compare COMMAND binweaver-cli compare ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/elf/clean-elf64le.so
                                  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/elf/variant-elf64le.so)
set_tests_properties(cli-compare PROPERTIES PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "\\+ libm\\.so\\.6")
add_test(NAME cli-map COMMAND binweaver-cli map ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/pe/clean-pe32plus.dll 0x2102)
set_tests_properties(cli-map PROPERTIES PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "file offset 0x702 \\(\\.rdata\\)")
add_test(NAME cli-scan COMMAND binweaver-cli scan ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus --recursive --jobs 4)
set_tests_properties(cli-scan PROPERTIES PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "scanned 2[0-9] files \\(0 unreadable\\)")
add_test(NAME cli-match COMMAND binweaver-cli match ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/examples/rules/example.rules
                                ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/pe/clean-pe32plus.dll)
set_tests_properties(cli-match PROPERTIES PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "fixture_exports_forwarder .*\\$fwd@0x8b0")
add_test(NAME cli-extract COMMAND binweaver-cli extract ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/pe/clean-pe32plus.dll
                                  section:.rdata ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/extracted-rdata.bin)
set_tests_properties(cli-extract PROPERTIES PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "wrote 1024 bytes from \\[0x600, \\+0x400\\)"
                     FIXTURES_SETUP extracted)
add_test(NAME cli-extract-content COMMAND binweaver-cli find ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/extracted-rdata.bin "KERNEL32.dll" --text)
set_tests_properties(cli-extract-content PROPERTIES PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "^0x140" FIXTURES_REQUIRED extracted)
add_test(NAME cli-fields COMMAND binweaver-cli fields ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/pe/clean-pe32plus.dll)
set_tests_properties(cli-fields PROPERTIES PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64.AddressOfEntryPoint +0x1000")
add_test(NAME cli-html COMMAND binweaver-cli inspect ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/elf/clean-elf64le.so --html)
set_tests_properties(cli-html PROPERTIES PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "<!doctype html>.*libc\\.so\\.6")
add_test(NAME cli-find COMMAND binweaver-cli find ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/pe/clean-pe32plus.dll "50 45 ?? 00")
set_tests_properties(cli-find PROPERTIES PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "^0x80")
add_test(NAME example-hardening-pe COMMAND binweaver-hardening-check ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/pe/clean-pe32plus.dll)
# The ELF fixture has no PT_GNU_RELRO: the gate must report it and fail.
add_test(NAME example-hardening-elf COMMAND binweaver-hardening-check ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/elf/clean-elf64le.so)
set_tests_properties(example-hardening-elf PROPERTIES WILL_FAIL TRUE)
add_test(NAME example-deps COMMAND binweaver-deps ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/corpus/pe/clean-pe32plus.dll)
set_tests_properties(example-deps PROPERTIES PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "KERNEL32.dll +2 import")

if(BINWEAVER_BUILD_GUI)
  find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Test)
  qt_add_executable(binweaver-gui-tests gui_tests.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(binweaver-gui-tests PRIVATE binweaver_gui Qt6::Test)
  target_compile_definitions(binweaver-gui-tests PRIVATE BINWEAVER_SOURCE_DIR="${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}")
  set_target_properties(binweaver-gui-tests PROPERTIES WIN32_EXECUTABLE OFF)
  add_test(NAME gui COMMAND binweaver-gui-tests)
  set_tests_properties(gui PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen")
endif()
